lines.trans: Traitors and spies are all around!
Chef, nobody is plotting evil against you.
You understand nothing about people, runt!
People often create problems for themselves.
Others mistakenly think the whole world is against them.
They are simply jealous of my great talent!

words.gloss: to envy, to be jealous of

lines.trans: But constant suspicions only ruin life.
Caution in the kitchen is never unnecessary.

words.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

lines.trans: Sometimes it is useful to simply trust your cooks.
I trust only my own frying pan.
With such a mood it is hard to enjoy life.
Enough lecturing me, go chop onions!
Right away, chef, I am already running to the kitchen.
Fear prevents people from seeing the truth around them.

words.gloss: to be in the way, to disturb

meanings.en: to run (in one direction), to flee, to escape
meanings.note: irregular mixed conjugation: бегу, бежишь, ..., бегут

examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!
Where are you running so fast?

examples.text: Надо бежать! Беги в деревню к маме.
examples.trans: You need to run! Run to the village to your mum's.

бывать.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

meanings.en: to happen, to exist, there can be
meanings.note: 3rd person бывает = there is / can be

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.
That happens.

examples.text: У мужчины, мальчик, бывает не только жена. Это моя девушка.
examples.trans: A man, my boy, can have more than just a wife. She's my girlfriend.
How is it in Hungary?
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('great').

examples.trans: The great Khan.
A great Russian writer.
A great holiday.
Everything's fine.
As you all know...
Share with everyone.
See?
I can see the toy car.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.
She was running after me (around me).
Look around.
She circled around me like a shark.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.trans: As you all know...
Does the governor support you?

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: + dative of person or thing trusted

examples.trans: I can trust you, right?
I don't trust him!

examples.text: А я ему, между прочим, не доверяю!
examples.trans: And by the way, I don't trust him!

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I'm thinking about work.
I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'life' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: That's life.
I want a different life.
Working. Making people's lives better.

завидовать.gloss: to envy, to be jealous of

examples.trans: All the boys envied him.
I envy you in a good way.

examples.text: У него было ружьё. Все мальчишки завидовали ему.
examples.trans: He had an air gun. All the boys envied him.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'мышлять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to plot, scheme', paired with 'замыслить'.

examples.text: Никто против вас не замышляет зла.
examples.trans: Nobody is plotting evil against you.

examples.text: Шеф, никто против вас не замышляет зла.
examples.trans: Chef, nobody is plotting evil against you.

meanings.note: the opposite of good: добро и зло = good and evil

examples.trans: Evil always comes back.
I don't mean any harm.

examples.text: Запомните: зло всегда возвращается к правителю.
examples.trans: Remember: evil always comes back to the ruler.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.
Dad and Mum.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: I'm going home.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
Sometimes it is useful to trust others.
Sometimes we do foolish things.

examples.text: Иногда наши победы бывают слишком странными.
examples.trans: Sometimes our victories turn out too strange.

meanings.note: Core Russian adv meaning 'all around' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: Oh, there is snow all around here!
There was thick forest all around.

examples.text: Ой, тут кругом снег! А где мы сидеть будем?
examples.trans: Oh, there is snow all around here! And where are we going to sit?
We're sitting in the kitchen.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.
And the kitchen is over there.

meanings.note: International noun in '-ция' (from Latin '-tio'), feminine declension. Common feminine noun meaning 'lecture, sermon' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Enough lecturing me!

examples.text: Хватит читать мне лекции, иди нарезать лук!
examples.trans: Enough lecturing me, go chop onions!

meanings.note: сказать лишнего = to say too much
сказать лишнего = to say too much

examples.trans: Yesterday I said too much to you.
Do you have a spare ticket?
The main thing is do not say unnecessary foolishness.
Onion, salt, pepper — and that's all.
Chop the onion for the salad.

examples.text: Попробуй! Лук, соль, перец — и всё.
examples.trans: Try it! Onion, salt, pepper — and that's all.

мешать.gloss: to be in the way, to disturb

meanings.en: to be in the way, to hinder

examples.trans: The radiators are in the way.
Don't bother me!

examples.text: Филиппыч, миксер проехать не может. Радиаторы мешают.
examples.trans: Filippych, the mixer truck can't get through. The radiators are in the way.

meanings.note: the end of a quarrel or war
the plural is used only in this sense

examples.trans: Now there's peace.
It's a big world.
Now we're at peace.
Where's my toy car?
That's mine.
No. That's mine.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: to cut into portions or pieces

examples.text: Вот теперь кусочки нарезаны красиво и аккуратно.
examples.trans: Now the pieces are cut beautifully and neatly.

examples.text: Сначала мелко нарежь лук и морковь.
examples.trans: First chop the onion and carrot finely.
I will cut the vegetables into even pieces.

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'строение'). Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'mood, spirits' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Вот с таким настроением и иди к Аникееву.
examples.trans: Go to Anikeev in just that mood.
I am in a good mood today.

examples.text: С таким настроением, конечно, не будет.
examples.trans: With an attitude like that, of course there won't be.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I don't know.
There wasn't enough money.
Chef, I didn't take it.

meanings.note: used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.trans: Never!

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.
No! Never!

meanings.note: needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: Nobody will come in.
I know the town like nobody else.

examples.text: Садитесь и держите дверь. Никто не войдёт.
examples.trans: Sit down and hold the door. Nobody will come in.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.trans: There's nothing left.
I don't know anything.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.note: playful derogatory nickname used by Chef Barinov for Max

examples.trans: Runt, are you still standing here?
The chef often called the newcomer a runt.

examples.text: Огузок, ты официально принят в штат нашего ресторана!
examples.trans: Rump, you are officially hired onto our restaurant staff!

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.trans: Give me just one.
I have one brother.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Core Russian pron meaning 'they' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: They are building a centre.
History will punish them.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

meanings.note: Abstract feminine noun formed with the Slavic suffix '-ость' ('-ness, -ity') from the corresponding adjective. Common feminine noun meaning 'caution, care, prudence' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Осторожность на кухне никогда не лишняя.
examples.trans: Caution in the kitchen is never unnecessary.

examples.text: Осторожность на кухне никогда не бывает лишней.
examples.trans: Caution in the kitchen is never unnecessary.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: People mistakenly think about bad things.

examples.text: Третьи ошибочно думают, что весь мир против них.
examples.trans: Others mistakenly think the whole world is against them.
There is this English chef.

examples.text: Есть такой английский повар. Я по его передачам научусь готовить.
examples.trans: There is this English chef. I will learn to cook from his shows.

examples.text: Я хочу работать поваром в ресторане.
examples.trans: I want to work as a cook in a restaurant.
This doesn't raise suspicion.
I have a suspicion.

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, упаковка маскирующая. Не вызывает подозрений.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, the packaging is camouflage. It doesn't raise suspicion.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'лезно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: It is useful to learn from mistakes.

examples.text: Иногда полезно просто доверять своим поварам.
examples.trans: Sometimes it is useful to simply trust your cooks.

meanings.note: понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I understand.
I want to go to the sea, you know?

examples.text: Я хочу нормально жить! Я хочу биде, понимаешь?
examples.trans: I want to live like a normal person! I want a bidet, do you understand?
Don't ruin my wonderful mood.

examples.text: Так, не портите мне прекрасное настроение.
examples.trans: Right, don't ruin my wonderful mood.

examples.text: Поверьте, вам это не надо. Вы так карму портите.
examples.trans: Believe us, you do not need this. You ruin your karma that way.
The test drive is only for regular clients.

examples.text: Я тоже могу быть постоянным клиентом!
examples.trans: I can be a regular client too!

examples.text: Тест-драйв у нас только для постоянных клиентов.
examples.trans: Our test drive is only for regular clients.

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine
as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.trans: Honestly, everything's fine.
That's true.

examples.text: Правда, Нин, всё нормально. Скажи что-нибудь, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Honestly, Nina, everything's fine. Say something, please.
He considered himself a traitor.
The traitors will be punished.

examples.text: Ничего я тебе не скажу, предатель!
examples.trans: I won't tell you anything, traitor!
That's not a problem.
I have a problem.
I know the problems of ordinary people.
I'm just tired.
It's easy.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: + genitive; can stand alone: Я против = I'm against it

examples.trans: I'm against it.
He is against the cluster.

examples.text: Все в городе хотят этот кластер. Только ты против.
examples.trans: Everyone in town wants this cluster. Only you are against it.
And his whole family is thrilled!
The children rejoiced at the first snow.
Do not celebrate too early.

meanings.en: dear, darling, my friend (in address: родной мой)

meanings.note: родной брат = full brother; родной город = hometown

examples.text: Ну что, родной мой, за тебя!
examples.trans: Well then, my dear friend, to you!
This is my hometown.

examples.text: Это будущий мэр Синеозерска! Ну что, родной мой, за тебя!
examples.trans: That is the future mayor of Sineozersk! Well then, my dear friend, to you!

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share with everyone.
I'm with Dad.
Share it all equally with everyone, understand?
I'll do it myself.
He knows himself.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: He keeps his word.
They are building their houses.

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?
I feel good.
He only thinks about himself.

examples.text: А с Пашей я снова чувствую себя женщиной.
examples.trans: And with Pasha I feel like a woman again.

meanings.note: pan with a handle used for frying food

examples.trans: A heavy frying pan was sizzling on the stove.

examples.text: Он быстро снял сковородку с огня.
examples.trans: He quickly took the frying pan off the heat.

examples.text: Во имя тяжёлой сковородки и половника!
examples.trans: In the name of the heavy frying pan and ladle!
Understood, chef!
Understood, chef! I will find the knife.

examples.text: Слушаюсь, шеф, я сделаю всё моментально.
examples.trans: Understood, chef, I will do everything instantly.
You create unnecessary problems for us.
The artist creates a new painting.

examples.text: Ты всегда создаёшь нам большие проблемы.
examples.trans: You always create big problems for us.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'трах'). Common masculine noun meaning 'fear' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Have you lost all fear?
I have no fear.

examples.text: Что смотрите, бандерлоги? Вы совсем страх потеряли?
examples.trans: What are you staring at, you monkeys? Have you lost all fear?

meanings.note: 'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I

examples.trans: What is this?
He's so kind.
Pavel Yuryevich, what is this?
You have no talent.

examples.text: У этой девочки большой талант к музыке.
examples.trans: This girl has a great talent for music.

examples.text: Потому что твой папа прав! У тебя нет таланта.
examples.trans: Because your dad is right! You have no talent.

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

examples.trans: I was only looking.
Just one.
I was only looking!

meanings.note: ordinal numeral: в третьем поколении = third-generation

examples.trans: This is my third time.
He lives on the third floor.

examples.text: Ты что, мафия? Ты же завхоз в третьем поколении.
examples.trans: What are you, the mafia? You're a supply manager, third generation.

meanings.note: requiring effort; impersonal: it is difficult

examples.trans: It is very hard to manage it.

examples.text: С таким настроением трудно радоваться жизни.
examples.trans: With such a mood it is hard to enjoy life.

examples.text: А с маленьким ребёнком справиться гораздо труднее!
examples.trans: And handling a little child is much harder!

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: You're greedy!
Have you got any more?
Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.
Dad is already home.
I'm already home.

meanings.note: impersonal, + genitive: денег не хватило = there wasn't enough money

examples.trans: There wasn't enough money.
That's enough!
Gum? I didn't have enough money.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: О, это, Аркашенька, бывает очень часто.
examples.trans: Oh, that happens very often, Arkashenka.
We often meet in the park.
I used to come see you often.

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: He is a good person.
There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to read', paired with 'прочитать'.

examples.trans: You don't read the small print.
I am reading an interesting book.

examples.text: Женщина, вы мелкими буквами не читаете. Наша фирма в этом не виновата.
examples.trans: Ma'am, you don't read the small print. Our firm isn't to blame for that.
What's this?
Look what I've got.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
examples.trans: Hi! Look what I've got.
Cleverly thought out, boss!
The boss signed the order.
The chef is in the kitchen.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'spy' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: What are you, a spy?
It's a film about a spy.
Traitors and spies are all around!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: I'm doing my homework.
I grew up here.
Chef, I didn't take it.
